name: domod
description: A todo list and notepad that last across sessions, shared between you and Claude

focusLimit.title: Items for you at once
focusLimit.description: The most open items Claude may give you at a time; Claude is told to aim for three. Items you add yourself are never refused.

harvest.title: Harvest action items
harvest.description: When Claude's reply asks something of you ("What you need to do", "Your turn"), a small model pulls out the action items and a card above the prompt lets you sort each one.

harvestTeammates.title: Harvest teammate messages
harvestTeammates.description: Also read messages that other sessions and teammates send into this one.

harvestModel.title: Harvest model
harvestModel.description: The model that reads replies for action items.

triageMinutes.title: Triage card timeout (minutes)
triageMinutes.description: Found items you leave unsorted disappear after this long; nothing is added unless you pick it.

runNow.title: Run now buttons
runNow.description: Claude's items get a Run button that sends the item to Claude as a prompt.

decisions.title: Decision buttons
decisions.description: Go/no-go items get Go and No-go buttons; your answer reaches Claude with your next prompt.

autoClose.title: Auto-close from commands
autoClose.description: When Claude runs gh pr merge or gh pr close on a PR an item names, or the PR shows merged, that item closes. /todo undo reopens it.

prStatus.title: PR status badges
prStatus.description: Checks the PRs that items name with gh and shows merged, approved or failing checks beside them.

prPollMinutes.title: PR check interval (minutes)
prPollMinutes.description: How often PR status is checked.

waitingOn.title: Waiting-on items
waitingOn.description: Items can wait on a named person (w:Name in the add box).

snooze.title: Snooze
snooze.description: Items can be hidden until later (zz in the pane, or /todo snooze <id> 2h|3d|tomorrow|mon).

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: A macOS notification when a snoozed item comes back or a PR an item names is merged.
